title: Damavik alert
description: An alert is the brain's only output of judgement, and it is never a black box: `explain` must be non-empty and must contain the human-readable reasons behind the score. The authoritative validator is `brain/damavik/schema.py::validate_alert`; `tests/test_schema.py` fails if this document drifts from it.

score.description: The maximum score of the contributing events.

rule.description: Rule id that produced this alert, e.g. `DMK-N-002`. Null for score-only alerts.

events.description: Event ids behind this alert, in causal order. This is what makes the dashboard subgraph possible.

iocs.description: Extracted indicators: sha256, dst, q, path, pkg, pid. Never empty — `damavik selftest` fails on an alert with no indicators.

explain.description: Every scoring reason and rule match, joined. Mandatory: an unexplainable alert is a bug, not a feature.

dedup.description: Suppression key: rule id + correlation group (or the primary indicator). Repeats within `alerts.cooldown_s` update this alert instead of creating a new one.

verdict.description: Aggregate verdict, informed by optional intel plugins. A signal, never a conclusion.
